text: The `step-1` proposal is clear, so I made no edits. `node Server/text-check.mjs` printed no flags, and the brief is for agents rather than the owner, so the owner-facing checks (ten-second read, screenshots) don't apply. I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
Review complete and accepted — no further action needed.

The step-3 brief is clear. `text-check` printed no flags, and what to build, what to prove and which docs to update are all stated as checkable asks. It is an agent-facing brief, so the owner-facing checks (ten seconds, shown not told) don't apply to it. I changed nothing in it and appended one "clear" line to `flags.jsonl`.
Task complete. Answer file at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/09/spawned/mastermind-ui-kit/past-work-answer.md` — five topics researched, existing work and gaps identified.

Step 3 is built, tested, and landed as its own task (marked complete in MAIN's session log), with the work left unmerged on `worktree/qf-2` as instructed.

**What shipped:**
- `Server/LayoutCheck.mjs` — class `LayoutCheck` + CLI (`node Server/LayoutCheck.mjs <base> <pages>... [--widths] [--json] [--baseline]`): headless `analyze()` + `PaddingContract.check()` per page×width, BROKEN (high-sev + padding misuse) vs OFF (med/low) counts, top findings, baseline diff for "new BROKEN", browser-context recycling every 40 navs.
- Wired into `Server/merge.mjs` right after the smoke run — report only, exit code ignored, skipped under `--skip-smoke`/`--quick`.
- Docs: `Server/readme.md` one-liner, DesignTool readme's new "Merge check" section.
- `Server/LayoutCheck.test.mjs` — pure-logic test, no browser, 0.05s.

**Proof** (worktree's own server, 5 pages × 2 widths): 10/10 rows reported, e.g. `/framework/ui/card/ 1200 BROKEN 1 OFF 11`. A deliberate scratch-page break (uncommitted, since deleted) reported `BROKEN 1 OFF 1`. Two independent measurements of `/framework/ui/card/` at 1200 agree: LayoutCheck said `BROKEN 1 OFF 11`; a hand-rolled Playwright one-off calling the same two functions directly returned `high:1,med:5,low:6,pad:0` → same numbers. `smoke.mjs` on the worktree exits 0.

**Branch:** `worktree/qf-2`, commits `0cca8ac2b`, `fa3b48f5c`, `24aa74d70`. Not merged.

One thing worth a second look: the BROKEN/OFF split is this task's own definition (DesignTool's rules.js/polish.js tiers aren't separable after roll-up), not an existing site convention — flagged in the task's `complete` evidence for whoever reviews it next.
